title: Caffeine After Noon Sleep Guard
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=espresso:shot
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(strftime(_time,"%H")>=12,caffeine_mg,0))) as afternoon_mg by _time
| eval risky=if(afternoon_mg>150,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Totals the caffeine you take after midday and flags the days likely to disturb your sleep.
value: Afternoon caffeine is a common hidden cause of poor sleep; flagging it links the habit to the consequence.
implementation: Ingest coffee logs into `index=personal`; alert on high afternoon caffeine.
visualization: Column chart of afternoon caffeine with a risk threshold.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the coffee you drink after midday and warns when it is enough to spoil your sleep.
